name: bring up eth0 statically
cmd:
ip link set eth0 up && ip addr add 192.168.86.100/24 dev eth0 && ip route add default via 192.168.86.1 && printf '192.0.2.1 api.anthropic.com
192.0.2.2 api.openai.com
192.0.2.3 generativelanguage.googleapis.com
192.0.2.4 api.x.ai
' >> /etc/hosts && echo brought-up

name: PROOF (throwaway config, removed here): key sandbox + reachability
cmd: mkdir -p /tmp/p5probe/temur && printf '%s' '{"provider":"anthropic","max_tokens":4096,"base_url":"https://api.anthropic.com","model":"claude-sonnet-5"}' > /tmp/p5probe/temur/config.json && XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/tmp/p5probe APP_SECRET_FILE=/tmp/p5probe/key temur doctor > /tmp/p5probe/doctor.txt 2>&1; grep -i 'key isolation\|bash key sandbox' /tmp/p5probe/doctor.txt; grep -iE '(un)?reachable:' /tmp/p5probe/doctor.txt; rm -rf /tmp/p5probe; [ ! -e /tmp/p5probe ] && echo PROBE-REMOVED

name: the snapshot carries NO config, NO key, and no leftover probe
APP_SECRET_FILE is NOT persisted anywhere
cmd: echo env=[$APP_SECRET_FILE]; grep -c APP_SECRET_FILE /root/.profile /etc/profile /etc/profile.d/*.sh 2>&1; [ -z "$APP_SECRET_FILE" ] && echo NO-SECRET-ENV-OK

name: ICRNL is ON, from the overlay, so Enter works in the wizard
